# Paterson

> Paterson is a retained executive search firm placing senior construction and real estate leaders — owner's representative, general contractor (GC-side) and developer-side — in New York, Miami and Dubai. A small, senior team runs every search itself, with no account managers or hand-offs between desks.

Legal entities: Paterson Group L.L.C-FZ (Dubai, U.A.E.) and its subsidiary Paterson USA L.L.C. (Delaware). Contact: info@patersoncompany.com

## For candidates
- [Candidates](https://www.patersoncompany.com/candidates): many senior roles never reach the market; send your details and Paterson reaches out when the right role appears.
- [Live roles](https://www.patersoncompany.com/jobs): current searches.

## For clients
- [Clients](https://www.patersoncompany.com/clients): senior construction and real estate hiring, filled in days rather than weeks through a network of candidates who already know their trade.
- [How a search runs](https://www.patersoncompany.com/services): a retained, mapped search for roles where the right hire is a handful of people who aren't looking.
